policy: Exact reviewed item IDs only. Composed materials use fixed component amounts. Distinct physical states retain their own identity. Ore and raw inputs are decomposition-only. Synthesis requires individual permission.

amber.name: Amber Resin
amber.basis: Fossil resin modeled with the approximate empirical formula C₁₀H₁₆O; an amorphous polymer mixture, not a defined compound or crystal.

amethyst.name: Amethyst
amethyst.basis: Named material retained separately from amorphous ingredients and other crystal forms. Mineral formulas are simplified end members; fantasy crystals include conserved fictional constituents.

arcane_crystal.name: Arcane Crystal
arcane_crystal.basis: Designed nominal composition for a retained material state, not a measured formula. No elemental separation, conversion to a precursor, or quality upgrade is provided. Crystalline silica carries one conserved fictional constituent per formula unit.

arcanium.name: Arcanium
arcanium.basis: Fictional conserved constituent shared by related mod materials; not a real periodic-table element.

astrion.name: Astrion
astrion.basis: Fictional conserved constituent shared by related mod materials; not a real periodic-table element.

awakened_supremium_essence.name: Awakened Supremium Essence
awakened_supremium_essence.basis: Awakening adds Cognizant Dust and elemental essences to Supremium; the awakened tier matches Insanium. Distinct conserved magical-material state; no conversion between tiers, essence, infused metal and gemstone.

beeswax.name: Beeswax
beeswax.basis: Natural honeycomb wax identity; vanilla honeycombs synthesize and Productive Bees wax recovers conservatively.

beryllium.name: Beryllium
beryllium.basis: Element identity; formula quantities are game units, not kilograms.

boron.name: Boron

brine.name: Brine

No elemental separation, conversion to a precursor, or quality upgrade is provided. The burnt powder state is separate from unburnt stone and decorative building blocks.

burnt_otherstone.name: Burnt Otherstone

saline_brine.name: Saline Brine
saline_brine.basis: Deep-Core Extractor marine concentrate pumped from Water bodies; refines cleanly into Sodium Chloride, Lithium and Water.

magmatic_filtrate.name: Magmatic Filtrate
magmatic_filtrate.basis: Deep-Core Extractor thermal siphon from Lava lakes; refines cleanly into Mineral Mix, Sulfur, Iron and Gold.

void_condensate.name: Void Condensate
void_condensate.basis: Deep-Core Extractor endgame vapor condensed over the End void; refines cleanly into Carbon, Silica, Enderion and Astrion.

ammonia.name: Ammonia
ammonia.basis: Haber-Bosch industrial nitrogen-hydrogen compound synthesized from atmospheric nitrogen and electrolyzed hydrogen.

adamant.basis: Oritech foundry/alloy/adamant uses one nickel ingot and one diamond. The shaped adamant_ingot recipe uses two of each. Fragment forge and pulverizer produce one dust per ingot, and smelting reverses that conversion.

advanced_alloy.basis: Energized Power alloy_furnace/advanced_alloy_ingot consumes three steel, three copper and three tin ingots. Only copper and tin are recovered across the interchangeable steel and Biosteel inputs.

ae2_quartz_vibrant_glass.basis: 1 quartz glass (1,000 silica) + 2 glowstone dust (2,000 cinderium + 2,000 silica).

andesite.basis: Simplified oxide composition on the common stone scale. Variants and reviewed mod forms share this ratio.

aquarine_copper.basis: Nautec mixes three copper with brine and kelp into six compounds. Purification can yield four ingots per compound, so only one eighth of a copper ingot is recovered per ingot.

awakened_supremium_essence.basis: Recovery only. Awakening requires Cognizant Dust from the Wither or the Ender Dragon and the Awakening Altar.

awakened_supremium_gemstone.basis: One Prosperity base and two exact-tier native ingredients. Higher tier essence is distinct from the lower tiers. The finished Awakened or Insanium material remains native manufacture only.

awakened_supremium_metal.basis: One Prosperity base and two exact-tier native ingredients. Higher tier essence is distinct from the lower tiers. The finished Awakened or Insanium material remains native manufacture only.

azurite.basis: The one-ingot native recipe consumes two Nuclear Waste and one Lapis Lazuli. Recover the identifiable lapis input only. Alternate fuel and waste are excluded from synthesis. The storage block is nine ingots.

bamboo.basis: Fast-growing woody grass: 1 bamboo = 100 cellulose, 1 bamboo block = 900 cellulose (exact 9:1; Energized Power Sawmill yields 3 planks = 600 <= 900).

basalt.basis: Simplified mafic oxide composition on the common stone scale of 3,000 units per block. Basalt uses the blackstone proportions because Hextale crucible transmutation turns either block into the other one to one. Variants and reviewed mod forms share this ratio.

beeswax.basis: Vanilla honeycomb holds 1,000 u beeswax and honeycomb block holds 4,000 u (four honeycombs). Productive Bees wax and nine-wax blocks recover the same substance without enabling centrifuge loops.

biosteel.basis: Oritech foundry/alloy/biosteel consumes one iron ingot and raw biopolymer. Its biomass and water routes do not yet have a shared biopolymer profile. Recovery is limited to iron.

blackstone.basis: Simplified oxide composition on the common stone scale, shared with basalt because Hextale crucible transmutation turns either block into the other one to one. Variants and reviewed mod forms share this ratio.

blaze.basis: Nether ember sulfur: 1 blaze powder = 250 Cdr + 250 S (synthesizable); 1 blaze rod = 4x powder (recovery-only; FTBIC Compressor converts 4 powder back to 1 rod).

blazegold.basis: Tier-two Goo turns one gold block into ore that drops three to four raw pieces. FTB Industrial Contraptions refines one raw piece into five ingots, so one block yields up to twenty ingots. Each ingot recovers one twentieth of the block and each raw piece five ingots. The native Goo tier still makes the material.

blue_ice.basis: All ice stores solid H2O. Vanilla compresses ice and packed ice at 9:1, but FTBIC and Refurbished Furniture also compress both grades at 1:1. Recovery uses the lowest shared yield. Compressed grades still require their native recipes.

bone.basis: Calcium phosphate bone mineral: 1 bone meal = 250, 1 bone = 2,000 (8x Oritech/SAG Mill bound), 1 bone block = 2,250 (exact 9x bone meal).

botania_elementium.basis: Botania Revived 2.0.4 Elven Gateway trades 2 Manasteel Ingots for 1 Elementium Ingot. Recovers the 2,000 u iron base; Elven Trade stays native.

botania_gaia_ingot.basis: Botania Revived 2.0.4 Gaia Spirit Ingot crafts from 1 Terrasteel Ingot and 4 Gaia Spirits. Recovery-only.

botania_gaia_spirit.basis: Botania Revived 2.0.4 Gaia Spirit is Guardian of Gaia boss loot, modeled as 500 Vital Essence + 500 Arcanium. Recovery-only; synthesis cannot replace the boss fight.

botania_glimmering_wood.basis: Botania Revived 2.0.4 Glimmering Livingwood/Dreamwood crafts from 1 log (1,200 cellulose) and 1 glowstone dust (1,000 cinderium + 1,000 silica); 4-to-3 bark wood uses conservative log recovery. Recovery-only.

botania_livingrock.basis: Botania Revived 2.0.4 Pure Daisy converts vanilla stone 1:1 into Livingrock. Recovery-only so Pure Daisy progression remains native.

botania_mana_diamond.basis: Botania Revived 2.0.4 Mana Diamond (10,000 Mana) and Elven-traded Dragonstone each retain 1,000 u diamond. Recovery-only so Mana Pool and Elven Gateway stay native.

botania_mana_glass.basis: Botania Revived 2.0.4 Mana Glass, Alfglass, and Bifrost Block derive 1:1 from vanilla glass (1,000 silica) via Mana Pool, Elven Gateway, and Rod of the Bifrost. Recovery-only.

botania_mana_pearl.basis: Botania Revived 2.0.4 Mana Pearl (6,000 Mana) and Elven-traded Pixie Dust each derive 1:1 from an Ender Pearl (1,000 enderion + 1,000 silica). Recovery-only.

botania_manasteel.basis: Botania Revived 2.0.4 Mana Pool infuses 1 iron ingot into 1 Manasteel Ingot (3,000 Mana). Recovers only the iron; Mana infusion stays native.

botania_metamorphic_stone.basis: Botania Revived 2.0.4 Marimorphosis converts vanilla stone 1:1 into eight biome metamorphic stones; smelting and masonry match vanilla stone oxide proportions.

botania_petal.basis: Botania Revived 2.0.4 mystical petals and flowers: 1 petal = 100 cellulose + 1,200 pigment (bounds 1:1 vanilla dye craft <= 400 pigment); 1 mystical flower = 2 petals (matching vanilla flowers at 200 cellulose + 2,400 pigment); 1 double flower = 4 petals; 1 petal block = 9 petals.

botania_quartz.basis: Botania Revived 2.0.4 specialty quartzes (Mana, Elven, Dark, Blaze, Lavender, Red, Sunny, Shimmer) and their 4-gem blocks each conservatively recover 1,000 u crystalline silica per quartz gem. Recovery-only.

botania_redstone_root.basis: Botania Revived 2.0.4 Redstone Root crafts from 1 redstone dust (1,000 arcanium + 1,000 silica) and 1 grass/fern (200 cellulose). Recovery-only.

botania_shimmerrock.basis: Botania Revived 2.0.4 Shimmerrock crafts from 1 Livingrock (stone oxides) and 1 Bifrost Block (1,000 silica). Recovery-only.

botania_shimmerwood.basis: Botania Revived 2.0.4 Shimmerwood Planks craft from 1 Dreamwood Planks (200 cellulose) and 1 Bifrost Block (1,000 silica). Recovery-only.

botania_shiny_flower.basis: Botania Revived 2.0.4 glimmering flowers craft from 1 mystical flower (200 cellulose + 2,400 pigment) and 2 glowstone dust (2,000 cinderium + 2,000 silica). Recovery-only crafted decoration.

botania_terrasteel.basis: Botania Revived 2.0.4 Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate fuses 1 Manasteel Ingot, 1 Mana Pearl, and 1 Mana Diamond (500,000 Mana) into 1 Terrasteel Ingot. Recovery-only.

brass.basis: Shared brass tags permit brand exchange. Infinity Nexus makes three brass ingots from one copper and one zinc, and three brass blocks from one copper block and one nickel block. Thaumaturge uses copper and Instrumentum without zinc. Three brass recover exactly the common 1,000 copper.

breeze.basis: Compressed atmospheric air charge: 1 wind charge = 160 N2 + 80 O2; 1 breeze rod = 6x wind charge (Integrated Dynamics squeezer bound).

bronze.basis: AllTheOres, FTB Industrial Contraptions and Infinity Nexus use three copper plus one tin for four bronze. Mekanism processing/bronze/ingot/from_infusing and dust/from_infusing use ten tin chemical for four; one tin dust supplies eighty chemical via enriching/enriched/tin and chemical_conversion/tin/from_enriched. Four bronze therefore recover exactly 3,000 copper and 125 tin, the cheaper route.

cake.basis: 3 wheat + 2 sugar + 1 egg (+ milk) craft 1 cake.

calcite.basis: Shared mineral and essence constituents. Supported blocks and powders use exact processing ratios.

carbon.basis: Processed elemental carbon (Mekanism Enriched Carbon, Oritech Carbon Fibre) kept distinct from coal/charcoal allotropes.

celestigem.basis: Just Dire Things tier-three Goo converts one diamond block into celestigem ore. Following the same conservative 1/20th block recovery rule used for ferricore and blazegold, each celestigem recovers 450 u diamond and each nine-gem block recovers 4,050 u. Recovery only.

cellulose.basis: One plank or cane holds 200 u cellulose; one natural log or stem holds 1,200 u (six planks, matching Mekanism Precision Sawmill lower-bound conservation). Planks and paper are decomposition-only; charcoal stays separate.

charged_certus_quartz.basis: AE2 charges Certus Quartz Crystals in a Charger. Stored as a distinct state-preserving crystal with synthesis disabled.

charged_redstone.basis: Applied Flux charges Redstone Crystals in an AE2 Charger and compresses nine Charged Redstone into a Charged Redstone Block. Stored as a distinct state-preserving crystal with synthesis disabled.

chorus_fruit.basis: End fruit: smelts 1:1 to popped chorus fruit; 4 popped craft 4 purpur blocks.

coarse_dirt.basis: 2 dirt + 2 gravel craft 4 coarse dirt; exact 1:1 ratio.

cocoa.basis: Cocoa beans carrying 800 organic pigment, matching Mekanism's 1-to-2 brown dye enriching bound.

conductive_alloy.basis: One exact share of the verified Ender IO alloy smelting batch.

constantan.basis: One copper and one nickel yield two Constantan.

cooked_meat.basis: Cooked meat/fish retaining the 400 protein of its raw cut.

coral_skeleton.basis: Dead reef calcium carbonate coral structures: 1 coral/fan = 250 CaCO3, 1 coral block = 1,000 CaCO3.

corrupted_arcane_crystal.basis: Recovery only. Corrupted Arcane Crystal is Forbidden Arcanus progression material; its native corruption stays required.

corrupti.basis: Four Corrupti Dust share the verified metal constituents of one Stygian Steel, one Arcane Crystal Dust and one quarter-pearl fragment. Two dusts recover exactly half of them. Blaze powder and Nether Wart stay in the native recipe.

crying_obsidian.basis: Arcane-infused obsidian; recovery only so native acquisition and nucleosynthesis stay required.

dark_steel.basis: One exact share of the verified Ender IO alloy smelting batch.

deepslate.basis: Simplified oxide composition on the common stone scale. Variants and reviewed mod forms share this ratio.

deorum.basis: One Deorum uses eighteen molten gold and thirty-six molten Arcane Crystal. The Clibano yields nine units per source item, so the ingot requires two gold and four Arcane Crystals. Recovery only. Deorum is Forbidden Arcanus progression material; its native Clibano alloying stays required.

desh.basis: Stellaris smelts one raw Desh per ingot and compacts nine into one block. The recipes do not specify constituents. The constituent split is a ReMatter model. ReMatter models one ingot as 550 iron, 250 titanium and 200 Stellar Essence.

diorite.basis: Simplified oxide composition on the common stone scale. Variants and reviewed mod forms share this ratio.

dragonyst.basis: Recover two amethyst dusts and one crushed End Stone from the verified ritual inputs. End Crystals, Dragon Breath and the Marid ritual remain required for production.

dripstone.basis: Travertine dripstone mineral: 4 pointed dripstone craft 1 dripstone block; Mekanism/Oritech crush 1 block back to 4.

duratium.basis: Oritech foundry/alloy/duratium uses platinum and netherite. Oritech atomicforge/duratium instead uses platinum and two reinforced carbon sheets. Platinum is their only verified common input.

dyed_candle.basis: 1 candle + 1 dye craft 1 dyed candle with uniform 100 pigment.

dyed_silica.basis: Dyed silica blocks (stained glass, concrete powder/concrete, red sand/sandstone): 1,000 silica + uniform 12 pigment (<= 100/8) for Mekanism Painting safety.

dyed_terracotta.basis: 8 terracotta + 1 dye craft 8 dyed terracotta; uniform 12 pigment (<= 100/8) keeps Mekanism repainting loop-free.

dyed_wool.basis: Dyed wool carries 1,000 protein plus a uniform 100 organic pigment (<= minimum dye) so repainting across colors in Mekanism Painting Machine can never create pigment.

echo.basis: Recovery only. Echo shards are Ancient City loot, and Occultism converts echo dust and shards one to one, so synthesis would release special loot.

eclipsealloy.basis: Tier-four Goo turns one Netherite block into ore that drops three to four raw pieces. FTB Industrial Contraptions refines one raw piece into five ingots, so one block yields up to twenty ingots. Each ingot recovers one twentieth of the block and each raw piece five ingots. The native Goo tier still makes the material.

egg.basis: Avian egg combining albumen protein and calcified shell.

electrum.basis: AllTheOres and FTB Industrial Contraptions alloy one gold and one silver into two. Oritech foundry/alloy/electrum uses gold and redstone instead. AllTheOres crafting/electrum/block_to_ingot and crafting/hammer/electrum/dust_from_ingot convert through common tags. Only gold is common to the two origins.

ember.basis: Applied Generators produces Ember with Fluix, gunpowder, blaze powder and lava. The cheapest demonstrated batch produces 64 from 16 of each solid input. Growth and the charged crystal routes stay distinct from the ReMatter recovery model.

end_steel.basis: One exact share of the verified Ender IO alloy smelting batch.

end_stone.basis: Shared mineral and essence constituents. Supported blocks and powders use exact processing ratios.

ender_pearl.basis: Shared mineral and essence constituents. Supported blocks and powders use exact processing ratios.

enderium.basis: Shared tags exchange Enderium made with platinum in AllTheOres and Enderium made with diamond in FTB Industrial Contraptions. Recover only the lead and pearl constituents common to both recipes.

energetic_alloy.basis: One exact share of the verified Ender IO alloy smelting batch.

energite.basis: Oritech foundry/alloy/energite and compat/powah/energizing/energite both consume one nickel ingot and one fluxite. The charged Fluxite material is retained in the alloy profile.

energized_steel.basis: Powah energizing/energized_steel consumes one iron ingot and one gold ingot to produce two energized steel ingots (500 iron + 500 gold each); blocks hold nine ingots. Recovery only.

entro.basis: ExtendedAE grows Entro crystals and repairs Entro dust using Fluix. The stored crystal state is a ReMatter model and the native growth or repair route is required.

fermented_spider_eye.basis: 1 spider eye + 1 sugar + 1 brown mushroom craft 1 fermented spider eye.

ferricore.basis: Tier-one Goo turns one iron block into ore that drops three to four raw pieces. FTB Industrial Contraptions refines one raw piece into five ingots, so one block yields up to twenty ingots. Each ingot recovers one twentieth of the block and each raw piece five ingots. The native Goo tier still makes the material.

flint.basis: Cryptocrystalline silica at 500 units per flint, bounded below Integrated Dynamics' 2-flint-per-gravel squeezer maximum.

flower.basis: Flowering plants: 2,400 pigment per small flower (4,800 per tall flower) bounds Integrated Dynamics Mechanical Squeezer's 6x/12x dye maximum so flowers remain loop-free and synthesizable.

fluix.basis: AE2 uses charged Certus, Nether Quartz and Redstone. AdvancedAE and Applied Generators make 64 Fluix from 16 of each, and their Fluix Dust duplication routes omit Redstone and Nether Quartz. Recover at most 250 units of Certus per Fluix. Charging, duplication and growth use native recipes.

fluxite.basis: Oritech recipes can produce fluxite by charging amethyst, lasing an amethyst cluster, processing platinum, or colliding electrum dust and redstone. They share no verified recoverable ingredient. The charged material remains intact.

fresh_fruit.basis: Sweet fresh produce: berries and melon slices = 1x, apple = 2x, full melon = 9x melon slices.

glow_ink_sac.basis: Bioluminescent ink matching Mekanism combining of 1 ink sac + 1 glowstone dust.

glowstone.basis: Shared mineral and essence constituents. Supported blocks and powders use exact processing ratios.

golden_apple.basis: 1 apple + 8 gold ingots craft 1 golden apple.

gourd.basis: Pumpkins: 400 starch bounds 4 crafted pumpkin seeds (4 x 100).

grain.basis: Starchy cereal crops and seeds: 1 seed = 100 starch, 1 wheat / bread / baked potato = 400 starch, 1 hay block = 3,600 starch (exact 9x wheat).

granite.basis: Simplified oxide composition on the common stone scale. Variants and reviewed mod forms share this ratio.

gunpowder.basis: Black-powder stoichiometry modeled from sulfur, elemental carbon and atmospheric nitrogen.

hexsteel.basis: Hextale alloying/hexsteel_ingot uses one iron and two Hextech dusts with the coal or charcoal tag. Iron and Hextech are recovered; the alternative fuel inputs are omitted.

hextech.basis: Hextale provides separate crystal and dust items. Hextale 1.9.0 has no data recipe establishing free reversibility, so both forms retain the Hextech material without a ReMatter output.

honey.basis: Concentrated nectar matching 1 honey bottle -> 3 sugar (600 sucrose) and 4 bottles <-> 1 honey block.

iesnium.basis: Occultism obtains this mineral from native Iesnium ore, then refines it. The shared constituents are a ReMatter model. Native acquisition remains required.

imperium_gemstone.basis: One Prosperity base and two exact-tier native ingredients. Higher tier essence is distinct from the lower tiers.

imperium_metal.basis: One Prosperity base and two exact-tier native ingredients. Higher tier essence is distinct from the lower tiers.

inferium_essence.basis: The common-tag furnace route yields one. Mining stays the native higher-yield route.

inferium_gemstone.basis: One Prosperity base and two exact-tier native ingredients. Higher tier essence is distinct from the lower tiers.

inferium_metal.basis: One Prosperity base and two exact-tier native ingredients. Higher tier essence is distinct from the lower tiers.

infinity.basis: Infinity Nexus mines native Infinity ore and refines it. Crushing and reversible storage recipes preserve the batch. The mineral constituents are a ReMatter model and production requires the native mineral.

infused_entro.basis: ExtendedAE alloys one Entro Ingot from Entro Dust, Gold Ingot and Lapis Lazuli; Crystal Assembler makes four from four of each; AdvancedAE and Applied Generators make 64 from 32 Entro Dust, 32 Gold and 32 Lapis. Recovery keeps the smallest verified share per ingot: 500 Entro, 500 gold and 500 Lapis Lazuli.

ink_sac.basis: Cephalopod melanin ink: 800 pigment matches Mekanism 1-ink-to-2-black-dye enriching bound.

insanium_essence.basis: Recovery only. Insanium is a top Mystical Agriculture tier; its native upgrade, awakening or seed progression stays required.

insanium_gemstone.basis: One Prosperity base and two exact-tier native ingredients. Higher tier essence is distinct from the lower tiers. The finished Awakened or Insanium material remains native manufacture only.

insanium_metal.basis: One Prosperity base and two exact-tier native ingredients. Higher tier essence is distinct from the lower tiers. The finished Awakened or Insanium material remains native manufacture only.

insulating_resin.basis: Applied Flux makes resin from Glowstone Dust, organic ingredients and #c:silicon. Applied Generators synthesizer/insulating_resin uses ae2:silicon without glowstone, and synthesizer/insulating_resin_duplicate turns 32 resin, 32 silicon and 32 sky dust into 64. Every route shares only one silicon item per resin, so each resin recovers 250 silicon. Firing changes the resin state.

invar.basis: AllTheOres and FTB Industrial Contraptions make three Invar from two iron and one nickel. Oritech compat/ato/foundry/alloy/invar makes two from one iron and one nickel. Recovery keeps the smaller amount of each element, 500 iron and one third of a nickel per invar, so three invar recover exactly 1,500 iron and 1,000 nickel. These minima undercut every single native route, so synthesis is disabled.

kelp.basis: Fresh marine kelp; smelts 1:1 to dried kelp (200 cellulose).

live_coral.basis: Living reef coral combining calcium carbonate skeleton and organic pigment.

living_soil.basis: Topsoil blocks carrying organic plant litter (grass block, podzol, rooted dirt).

lumium.basis: Three tin, one silver and four glowstone dust yield four Lumium. The glowstone contributes silica and Cinderium.

lumivex.basis: Exact recovery of one quarter of the preparation batch. Silica remains bound instead of releasing elemental silicon.

lumivex_powder.basis: Exact recovery of one quarter of the preparation batch. Silica remains bound instead of releasing elemental silicon.

magma.basis: Solidified volcanic mineral mix matching 1:1 lava drying and stone liquefaction.

magma_cream.basis: 1 slime ball + 1 blaze powder craft 1 magma cream.

mekanism_alloy_atomic.basis: 1 reinforced alloy + 40 mB refined obsidian (1/2 enriched refined obsidian).

mekanism_alloy_infused.basis: 1 copper ingot + 10 mB redstone (1/8 enriched redstone = 125 arcanium + 125 silica).

mekanism_alloy_reinforced.basis: 1 infused alloy + 20 mB diamond (1/4 enriched diamond = 250 diamond).

mekanism_enriched_iron.basis: 1 iron ingot + 10 mB carbon chemical (1/8 enriched carbon, conservative 5 carbon matching steel = 10 carbon).

mekanism_hdpe.basis: High-density polyethylene polymerized from 50 mB ethene (C2H4); sheet = 3 pellets, rod = 4, stick = 8.

mekanism_substrate.basis: 2 bio fuel + 10 mB water + 100 mB hydrogen in Mekanism PRC.

mud.basis: 1 dirt + 250 mB water form 1 mud; matches Energized Power Fluid Transposer and Integrated Dynamics Squeezer 1:1.

mundabitur.basis: Four Mundabitur Dust share one Arcane Crystal Dust and one redstone. The other crafting reagents remain required by the native recipe.

mycelium.basis: Fungal topsoil carrying nitrogenous mycelium network.

naquadah.basis: Mekanism Extras obtains raw Naquadah from its ores. Native smelting uses one ore or raw Naquadah per ingot. The constituent split is a ReMatter model and synthesis cannot replace the native ore route. ReMatter models one ingot as 600 uranium and 400 Stellar Essence.

natural_ice.basis: All ice stores solid H2O. Vanilla compresses ice and packed ice at 9:1, but FTBIC and Refurbished Furniture also compress both grades at 1:1. Recovery uses the lowest shared yield. Compressed grades still require their native recipes.

neptunium.basis: Aquaculture supplies Neptunium through Neptune’s Bounty fishing loot. Equipment smelting and reversible storage retain Neptunium. The constituent split is a ReMatter model and synthesis cannot replace fishing. ReMatter models one ingot as 150 gold, 650 iron and 200 Vital Essence.

nether_wart.basis: Nether fungal crop: 9 nether wart craft 1 nether wart block.

netherite.basis: Native routes differ: vanilla uses four gold ingots and four Netherite Scrap, FTB Industrial Contraptions alloy_smelting/netherite_ingot two of each, Oritech foundry/alloy/netherite one of each, and Mekanism processing/netherite/scrap_to_dust four scrap with forty gold chemical, one eighth of a gold dust. Recovery keeps the smallest amount of each element: 500 gold and 1,000 Netherium. These minima undercut every native route, so synthesis is disabled.

netherite_scrap.basis: Netherite Scrap is an ore-derived base material like diamond, not loot or a boss item. Its Netherium only enters storage by decomposing debris-derived items, so synthesis is a one-to-one round trip.

netherrack.basis: Shared mineral and essence constituents. Supported blocks and powders use exact processing ratios.

novite.basis: Stellaris smelts one raw Novite per ingot and compacts nine into one block. The recipes do not specify constituents. The constituent split is a ReMatter model.

obsidian.basis: Shared mineral constituents. Four dusts contain one block. Recovery only: Occultism gray_paste/obsidian and crystallize/obsidian turn one dust into a whole block, and Ender IO grinding balls mill one block into up to eight dusts.

occultism_witherite.basis: Three Witherite Dust share one Netherite Dust and one crushed Blackstone. The Wither Skeleton Skull, Wither Rose and Afrit ritual remain required for production.

organic_dye.basis: Vanilla dyes modeled with organic pigment at 400 (primary), 200 (secondary), 150 (light gray) and 100 (magenta) units so 4x and 6x Mekanism dye combining never creates pigment.

organic_fiber.basis: Natural keratin/silk protein fiber: 1 string = 250 protein, 1 white wool = 1,000 protein (4 string), 1 cobweb = 1,250 protein (5 string Botania crafting bound; synthesis disabled with Mekanism).

oritech_clay_catalyst_beads.basis: Oritech Assembler makes 32 beads from 2 clay + 1 sand + 1 redstone; 16 beads recover half that batch exactly.

oritech_silicon_wafer.basis: 4 silicon wafers from 1 carbon fibre + 1,000 mB silicon wash (= 4 silicon -> 250 C + 250 Si each).

packed_ice.basis: All ice stores solid H2O. Vanilla compresses ice and packed ice at 9:1, but FTBIC and Refurbished Furniture also compress both grades at 1:1. Recovery uses the lowest shared yield. Compressed grades still require their native recipes.

packed_mud.basis: 1 mud + 1 wheat craft 1 packed mud; 4 packed mud craft 4 mud bricks.

plastic.basis: Oritech does not specify a polymer. ReMatter models finished plastic as polyethylene (C2H4)n and recovers carbon and molecular hydrogen. Oritech centrifuge/fluid/plasticbiobetter turns one polymer resin into four sheets, so a sheet recovers one quarter of a resin. A block packs exactly nine sheets.

polymer_resin.basis: One resin equals four plastic sheets, the best native yield of Oritech centrifuge/fluid/plasticbiobetter; the furnace and water centrifuge routes yield fewer sheets and lose material. The resin itself stands for its unprofiled naphtha, biodiesel or biomass feedstock, a renewable organic source.

prometheum.basis: Oritech atomicforge/prometheum consumes a Heisenberg Compensator and two Overcharged Crystals. Both compensator recipes use two adamant ingots. Recovery follows those two verified common ingots; the remaining components are excluded.

prosperity_essence.basis: The common-tag furnace route yields one. Mining stays the native higher-yield route.

prosperity_gemstone.basis: One iron ingot or diamond and four Prosperity Shards supply the native base.

prosperity_metal.basis: One iron ingot or diamond and four Prosperity Shards supply the native base.

prudentium_gemstone.basis: One Prosperity base and two exact-tier native ingredients. Higher tier essence is distinct from the lower tiers.

prudentium_metal.basis: One Prosperity base and two exact-tier native ingredients. Higher tier essence is distinct from the lower tiers.

pulsating_alloy.basis: Ender IO alloy_smelting/pulsating_alloy_ingot and FTB Industrial Contraptions alloy_smelting/enderio_pulsating_alloy_ingot use one iron and one ender pearl for two ingots.

pumpkin_pie.basis: 1 pumpkin + 1 sugar + 1 egg craft 1 pumpkin pie (dry solids).

quantum_alloy.basis: AdvancedAE react/quantum_alloy consumes four copper ingots plus singularities and quantum infusion fluid for one alloy; blocks hold nine alloys. Recovers only the four copper ingots conservatively.

quantum_alloy_plate.basis: 8 quantum alloy (32,000 copper) + 2 netherite ingots (1,000 gold + 2,000 netherium), ignoring Nether Star.

quartz.basis: Crystalline quartz keeps its own identity; gems, dusts, nuggets and blocks share one batch. The gem is recovery-only because Ender IO grinding balls raise its milling bonus.

radiant_alloy.basis: Hextale 1.9.0 alloying/radiant_alloy_ingot uses two gold, one charged Hexsteel and two gemstone dusts for two ingots. Gold is the verified portion; the charged and gemstone inputs are excluded.

raw_meat.basis: Raw animal protein and moisture; cooking retains 400 protein.

red_nether_bricks.basis: 2 nether bricks + 2 nether wart craft 1 red nether bricks block.

redstone.basis: Shared mineral and essence constituents. Supported blocks and powders use exact processing ratios.

redstone_alloy.basis: Ender IO alloy_smelting/redstone_alloy_ingot uses one copper and one redstone. Energized Power alloy_furnace/redstone_alloy_ingot uses tin, silicon and two redstone. The shared material profiles recover only one redstone batch.

redstone_crystal.basis: Applied Flux forms Redstone Crystals in water from Redstone Block, Fluix and Sky Stone Dust. Stored as a distinct state-preserving crystal with synthesis disabled.

refined_glowstone.basis: Recovers the original mineral constituents. Osmium is a machine reagent and direct synthesis is disabled.

refined_obsidian.basis: Recovers the original mineral constituents. Osmium is a machine reagent and direct synthesis is disabled.

refined_obsidian_precursor.basis: One obsidian dust with 10 diamond chemical units. Eight batches use one enriched diamond.

replica.basis: Replication smelts one raw Replica to one ingot and compresses nine ingots into a block. Its native mineral has no recipe-defined composition. The constituent split is a ReMatter model and production requires the native mineral. ReMatter models one ingot as 600 silicon and 400 Quantum Essence.

rhevon.basis: Exact recovery of one quarter of the preparation batch. Silica remains bound instead of releasing elemental silicon.

rhevon_powder.basis: Exact recovery of one quarter of the preparation batch. Silica remains bound instead of releasing elemental silicon.

riftmetal.basis: Hextale 1.9.0 alloying/riftmetal_ingot uses one Radiant Alloy and two raw Riftmetal. Recovery includes the verified gold portion of Radiant Alloy; the ore and charged-material constituents are unspecified.

rs_quartz_enriched_copper.basis: 3 copper ingots + 1 Nether Quartz craft 4 quartz-enriched copper.

rs_quartz_enriched_iron.basis: 3 iron ingots + 1 Nether Quartz craft 4 quartz-enriched iron.

sculk.basis: Deep-dark organic biofilm on mineral substrate.

scute.basis: Calcified keratinous scute and rabbit foot.

sea_lantern.basis: 4 prismarine shards + 5 prismarine crystals craft 1 sea lantern.

shulker_shell.basis: End carapace combining mineral shell and Enderion.

signalum.basis: Three copper, one silver and four redstone dust yield four Signalum. The redstone contributes silica and Arcane Essence.

silicon.basis: FTBIC separates one quartz into three Silicon Gems. AE2, Energized Power, ExtendedAE, FTBIC, Oritech and other mods share #c:silicon; storage recipes exchange brands. Oritech yields four silicon per sand with silicon wash, and ExtendedAE yields 24 from a blend batch using six sand and additional quartz. Recover 250 silicon units per exchangeable item so the sand routes stay within the accounted silicon input.

slime.basis: Hydrogel mucin slime: 9 slime balls craft 1 slime block.

soil.basis: Simplified soil of silica, organic carbon and bound water. The soil separation process releases these constituents.

soul_sand.basis: Nether soul sediment matching Mekanism 1:1 soul_soil-to-soul_sand crushing.

soularium.basis: Ender IO alloy_smelting/soularium_ingot uses one gold plus either soul sand or soul soil. Only the gold input has a reviewed shared constituent profile.

soulium_gemstone.basis: One Prosperity base and two Soulium Dust. The finished Soulium material remains native manufacture only.

soulium_metal.basis: One Prosperity base and two Soulium Dust. The finished Soulium material remains native manufacture only.

stainless_steel.basis: The largest native batch makes seven stainless steel from two steel ingots plus modifiers. Seven ingots recover exactly the 2,000 iron of that steel; optional additives are excluded. Native alloying remains required.

steel.basis: The reviewed steel routes use iron and carbon-bearing feedstock, including Oritech foundry/alloy/steel, Energized Power alloy_furnace/steel_ingot, Mekanism processing/steel/enriched_iron_to_dust and Infinity Nexus smeltery/infinity/steel_from_smeltery. Every route uses at least one iron ingot and more carbon than the modelled low-carbon steel of 1,000 iron and 10 carbon per ingot.

stellarite.basis: Recovery only. Stellarite is Forbidden Arcanus progression material; its native Stella Arcanum mining and Hephaestus Forge progression stays required.

stellarum.basis: Infinity Nexus fermentation/infinity_stelarium_ingot transforms one Infinity Ingot with Starliquid Water. Only the conserved material from that ingot is recovered.

stone.basis: Simplified oxide composition on the common stone scale: equal silica, alumina and calcium oxide. Cobblestone shares the ratio, and lava melts from the same mineral mix.

stygian_steel.basis: One Stygian Steel uses four copper, two gold, two iron and four Asterite chunks. Recover the three verified metals and keep Asterite processing in the Clibano.

sugar.basis: Refined sucrose sugar (200 units per item; 3 sugar = 1 honey bottle sucrose).

supremium_essence.basis: Recovery only. Supremium is a top Mystical Agriculture tier; its native upgrade, awakening or seed progression stays required.

supremium_gemstone.basis: One Prosperity base and two exact-tier native ingredients. Higher tier essence is distinct from the lower tiers. Recovery only. Supremium is a top Mystical Agriculture tier; its native upgrade, awakening or seed progression stays required.

supremium_metal.basis: One Prosperity base and two exact-tier native ingredients. Higher tier essence is distinct from the lower tiers. Recovery only. Supremium is a top Mystical Agriculture tier; its native upgrade, awakening or seed progression stays required.

tertium_gemstone.basis: One Prosperity base and two exact-tier native ingredients. Higher tier essence is distinct from the lower tiers.

tertium_metal.basis: One Prosperity base and two exact-tier native ingredients. Higher tier essence is distinct from the lower tiers.

thaumium.basis: Thaumaturge crucible/ingot_thaumium uses an iron ingot with Terra and Praecantatio. Only the iron is recovered. Aspects and research remain part of the native route.

tinted_glass.basis: 1 glass + 4 amethyst shards craft 2 tinted glass.

tough_alloy.basis: The largest native batch makes four tough alloy from one steel ingot and one lead ingot. Each ingot recovers exactly a quarter of the steel iron and the lead; boron and other additives are excluded. Native alloying remains required.

tuff.basis: Simplified oxide composition on the common stone scale. Variants and reviewed mod forms share this ratio.

uncured_insulating_resin.basis: Applied Flux makes resin from Glowstone Dust, organic ingredients and #c:silicon. Applied Generators synthesizer/insulating_resin uses ae2:silicon without glowstone, and synthesizer/insulating_resin_duplicate turns 32 resin, 32 silicon and 32 sky dust into 64. Every route shares only one silicon item per resin, so each resin recovers 250 silicon.

vibrant_alloy.basis: One exact share of the verified Ender IO alloy smelting batch.

virelite.basis: Exact recovery of one quarter of the four-piece batch. Sand silica, quartz and clay stay bound; no elemental silicon, aluminum or gas is released.

virelite_blend.basis: Exact recovery of one quarter of the four-piece batch. Sand silica, quartz and clay stay bound; no elemental silicon, aluminum or gas is released.

wet_sponge.basis: Water-saturated sponge; dries 1:1 back to sponge.
